about_the_game:
Defense&Making is a tile-based strategy game where you become the Demon Lord and design your own dungeon to fight off invading enemies.

From the path enemies take, to where traps are placed and which monsters are summoned—every tactical decision is in your hands.

Each element works together to create your own unique defense strategy.

This demo version offers a glimpse into the game’s core systems and mechanics.

Demo Content

  • Play through one full stage

  • Build your dungeon using randomly provided tiles and cards

  • Strategically place traps and summon monsters to defend your territory

  • Experience the game’s core build-and-defend loop

  • Includes a sample of choice-based narrative elements

  • Research, shop, and save/load systems

This demo is designed to showcase the core battle and construction systems of Defense&Making. Try building your dungeon, setting your own strategy, and stopping invaders—your way.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is set in a dark medieval fantasy world, depicting a society where survival of the fittest, discrimination, and violence are part of everyday life.
Within the game's narrative and worldbuilding, the following mature themes are indirectly or contextually present.

While the game explores the brutality of the world and poses moral questions through these darker themes, it avoids explicit scenes that may cause direct discomfort to players.
However, we kindly ask players who may be sensitive to such settings and tones to take this into consideration before playing.
